fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-08-19, a document allegedly prepared using forged details of the complainant was used to seek a payment of Rs. 50,000. The time of the incident was given as 15:50 on 2025-08-16. Ramya Bai approached Chittoor Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000232. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The account reference SYN-ACC-100064 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. A person named Ganesh Selvam, associated with the number 9000000247, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents and physical documents.
